story:
Rex the Dog Who Complained Too Much

In a small village with green fields, lived a playful dog named Rex.

Rex loved running and playing.

But there was one problem…

Rex complained about everything.

“It’s too hot!” Rex barked on sunny days.

“It’s too cold!” he barked on chilly mornings.

“It’s too windy!”

“It’s too quiet!”

No matter what, Rex always found something to complain about.

One day, his friend Mia the Goat said,

“Let’s play outside!”

Rex looked at the sky.

“It might rain,” he said.

“I don’t want to go.”

Mia went alone.

She had lots of fun.

Later, it started to rain.

Pitter-patter…

Rex stayed inside.

“I don’t like rain,” he grumbled.

But then he heard laughter outside.

Rex peeked out.

Mia was jumping in puddles!

Splash! Splash!

She looked so happy.

Rex stepped outside.

He touched the puddle.

Splash!

He jumped again.

Splash! Splash!

“This is fun!” he said.

Rex laughed and played in the rain.

“I shouldn’t complain so much,” he said.

Don’t focus on what’s wrong.

Look for what’s fun and good.

The End
